answer: The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, converted to a slow vesting stream, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the quill of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. A walnut of per-task receipts records who did what, and the echo of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
